stem:
Irfan counts the sparrows on the school playground one afternoon. A classmate says this count is a population. A population is a group of the same kind of organisms in the same habitat at a given place and time.

Which condition must be true for Irfan's count to be a population?

options.text: The count includes only sparrows, all counted on the same playground at the same time.
The count includes every kind of organism living anywhere near the playground.
The count includes sparrows mixed with other kinds of organisms counted in different places.
The count includes sparrows from many distant habitats, added together from different times.

teacher.key_rationale: A population needs one kind of organism counted in one habitat at one place and time. Mixing kinds, places, or times breaks that definition.
